author: smcarus
title: Will the central bank of the United States have cut its policy rate by 30 April 2027?
summary: Give the probability that the central bank policy rate of the United States (BIS daily series) on 30 April 2027 is lower than on the day entries close, 31 March 2027. The policy rate is the interest rate the central bank sets; a cut makes borrowing cheaper and usually happens when inflation is falling or the economy is weak.
knownLimits: BIS daily data can lag a decision by a few days.
Whether a meeting falls in the window matters; check the central bank's own calendar before answering.
